guide.title: {{name}}: fix the measurements
guide.step1: On the printed page, measure from the top-left corner of the paper to the first cross. It should be exactly 20 mm.
guide.step2: Enter the difference in the printer's shift. A cross printed 1 mm too far right needs left–right −1.
guide.step3: Print the page again and check that the cross is now at 20 mm.

help.schoolName: The school's name. It shows on receipts, invoices and printouts. It cannot be left empty.
help.logo: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 512 KB and 2048 pixels per side. It saves as soon as you pick the image.
help.organisationValues: Names used to arrange classes and sections. A value that a class or section still uses cannot be removed; rename it instead.
help.academicYearStartMonth: The month the academic year starts, 1 to 12.
help.termLabel: What a grading period is called in exams and results: Term, Semester or Trimester.
help.calendarCountry: Public holidays come from this country.
help.lateAfter: A student who arrives after this time is marked late.
help.absentAfter: A student who arrives after this time is marked absent.
help.correctionWindowDays: Past attendance can be corrected for this many days; 0 to 365.
help.lowAttendanceThresholdPercent: A student below this is shown as low attendance; 0 to 100.
help.autoAbsentEnabled: When on, the guardian of every absent student gets a message automatically, every day. You confirm once before it turns on.
help.arrivalNoticeEnabled: When on, a guardian who asks for it gets a message when their child arrives at school.
help.arrivalNoticeSmsAllowed: When on, the arrival message can go by SMS, which spends the school's SMS credit.
help.escalateAfterSchoolDays: If a status is not reported for this many school days, the head teacher and admin are told; 1 to 10, holidays are not counted.
help.approvalMode: How an admin confirms once more before a sensitive action: OTP only, or OTP or password.
help.requireSecondApprover: When on, cancelling a payment always needs a second person. When off, the only admin can approve it themselves.
help.lateFeeGraceDays: No late fee is charged for this many days after the bill's due date; 0 to 60.
help.lateFeeValue: For a percentage, 0 to 100. For a flat amount, zero or more taka.
help.smsProvider: The company all of this school's SMS go through. Test the connection before you change it.
help.mimsmsSenderId: Only for MimSMS, and then it is required. Use the name the company approved.
help.whatsappPhoneNumberId: The long number in Meta's WhatsApp Manager, not a phone number. It cannot be left empty.
help.messengerPageId: The ID of the school's Facebook page. Find it under the page's About section. It cannot be left empty.
help.emailFrom: The address the recipient sees. Enter a valid email address.
help.emailPort: 1 to 65535; usually 587. Do not change it unless your email server says so.
help.withholdAdmitCardForDues: When on, a family cannot print the admit card of a student with dues from the portal. Staff can still print it, with a warning. Off at the start.
help.serialPrefix: 2 to 8 capital English letters or digits. It goes before every certificate serial number. It can be left empty.
help.printerName: 1 to 80 characters. You pick the printer by this name when you print.
help.printerOffset: Enter how many mm the measuring page printed off; −10 to 10. The up–down field has the same limit.
help.otpLoginEnabled: When off, everyone in this school must sign in with a password. If someone is in several schools, sign-in with a code is off for them as soon as it is off in any one of them. On at the start.

greenweb.apiKey: Copy it from your Greenweb account page. After saving, the full key is never shown again.
greenweb.apiUrl: Leave empty to use the company's own address.

mimsms.apiKey: Copy it from your MimSMS account page. After saving, the full key is never shown again.
mimsms.senderId: The name people see as the sender. Use the one the company approved.
mimsms.apiUrl: Leave empty to use the company's own address.

onecodesoft.apiKey: Copy it from your OneCodeSoft account page. After saving, the full key is never shown again.
onecodesoft.senderId: The name people see as the sender. Use the one the company approved.
onecodesoft.apiUrl: Copy the base address from OneCodeSoft Dashboard › API. It must end with /api.

smtp.port: Usually 587. Change it only if your email server says so.

meta-cloud.phoneNumberId: Find it in Meta's WhatsApp Manager. It is a long number, not a phone number.
meta-cloud.apiVersion: Leave empty to use the version the app is set to.

meta-page.pageId: Find it under the page's About section.
